d.ko: Meat Train is an open world zombie survival game where you operate a train that uses MEAT for FUEL. Scavenge for weapons and loot while you explore a wasteland where everything wants you dead. Upgrade your train and attempt to destroy GRM: a rogue AI that has enslaved what's left of humanity.
